Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of PG.
Operating income reached $14.5 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
We delivered record revenue of $19.1 billion this quarter, representing 25% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $19.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 25% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
